topic: New Funding Opportunities at NSF of Interest to the Aiche Research Community
title: New Funding Opportunities at NSF of Interest to the Aiche Research Community
session_title: New Funding Opportunities at NSF and Program Officer Panel Discussion
abstract: This workshop will highlight Engineering Directorate and cross Directorate funding opportunities at the National Science Foundation that may be of interest to the AIChE Research communities. We will also discuss programs of NSF’s newest directorate, Technology, Innovation and Partnerships (TIP). Example programs including Future Manufacturing, Accelerating Innovations in Biomanufacturing with the DOE’s Agile BioFoundry, the NSF/CASIS Collaboration on Transport Phenomena Research on the International Space Station.
presenting_author: Jeanne VanBriesen | National Science Foundation, Alexandria, VA
authors: Jeanne VanBriesen | National Science Foundation, Alexandria, VA
